full_text: Intro Encompass® Implementation Services for Mortgage Lenders Partner with us for hassle-free Encompass® Implementation Services that will set the foundation for your continued success in the mortgage industry. From initial consultation to post-implementation support, we empower your mortgage team every step of the way, maximizing the potential of your Encompass® loan origination system to drive exceptional lending results. When it’s time to implement or re-implement Encompass®, consider only working with Certified Encompass Administrators by ICE Mortgage Technology. Professionally implemented Encompass LOS will help lower the loan origination costs, minimize risks, and ultimately result in a better return on investment. Work With Best in The Mortgage Tech! Full Name Email Contact No. Message Page URL Home » Encompass Implementation Services What is Encompass ? For those unaware of this amazing digital platform, Encompass is software that helps lenders manage every bit of the loan origination process. Encompass360 was initially a product of Elli Mae, which is currently a part of ICE Mortgage Technology, Inc. Now called simply Encompass, a cloud-based platform brings next-level administration throughout the entire loan lifecycle. Encompass LOS implementation enables everyone involved in the lending process, from underwriters to MLOs, to originate more loans, monitor them during the initial stage, and track them till the loan is closed. All of that while minimizing the expenses, lowering risks, and reducing the loan closing time. Encompass mortgage software offers an unparalleled digital experience to the mortgage lending industry! So, what does Encompass mean for your company? An organization with Encompass loan software benefits from improved automation alongside expedited closings using a workforce of empowered employees who work with easy-to-use adaptable solutions. The marketplace success depends on adaptability and Encompass mortgage solutions function as the foundational technology for market leadership. So, let our Encompass implementation services take your business to new heights of success! (from current service page of Encompass Implementation) Encompass Implementation in Mortgage Industry Implementation or setup of Encompass from ICE Mortgage Technology (formerly Ellie Mae) by Awesome Technologies Inc. is the process of integrating this cloud-based loan origination system into your lending business. Designed for medium to large-sized mortgage firms, this all-in-one mortgage management solution helps lenders generate more loans, simplifies loan management, increases productivity, and ultimately increases profits. Implementing Encompass also helps speed up the underwriting process. Think of it as an all-in-one solution for your mortgage lending digital needs. Encompass Digital Mortgage Software – Revolutionizing Lending Processes Originate More High-Quality Loans Minimize Loan Closing Time Make Loan Processing Easier & Faster Increase Profit Margins Lower Loan Handling Costs Experience Superior Workflow Why Choose Awesome Technologies Inc for Encompass LOS Implementation? Certified Ellie Mae Encompass Consultants Our certified consultants have a comprehensive understanding of Ellie Mae Encompass architecture and compliance framework. They are always updated with recent releases, to be able to set up the most future-proof system configuration. Why not work with a licensed professional that will help you secure your LOS in alignment with what makes business sense and what is required by lenders on behalf of federal regulatory bodies? Proven Success with Mortgage Firms in the U.S. Thinking of how to implement Encompass loan origination system? We have a successful track record delivering seamless LOS implementations to retail, wholesale and correspondent lenders in over 30 states. Post LOS implementation details and contacts indicate money and time saved based on faster closing time, less compliance issues, and ultimately a better return on their investment. Case studies and client testimonials evidence the dedication of mortgage tech we have for excellence, implementation, and measurable outcomes. End-to-End Technical & Functional Support From initial designs to long-term maintenance, we offer unrivaled support related to all functional and technical aspects of Encompass software for mortgage. Our consultants are able to assist lenders and title companies immediately with complex configuration, integrations and optimization after they go live. Lenders will experience less internal burden on their teams if they outsource their Encompass needs to a trusted, responsive partner. Why Do You Need Encompass Implementation Provider? If you are looking for a partner to help you implement or re-implement Encompass®, make Awesome Technologies Inc. your first choice. Having done it hundreds of times, we are Encompass implementation experts who believe in making the right move with every project. With zero-failed implementation projects, we have the expertise and confidence to set up your Encompass® software to attract success to your lending business. We don’t just implement and roll out your Encompass platform but also provide hands-on training to your tech team during the implementation process. It’s crucial to run your lending operations smoothly. Simply handing over the documentation isn’t enough to deliver the “experience” from our certified Encompass Admins to your team. We work hard to make the best out of the knowledge-sharing process. Proud To Be The Best Ellie Mae Encompass Implementation Experts We Guarantee The Right Implementation Over the years, we have built a solid reputation for delivering successful Encompass® implementations for countless mortgage companies. Encompass® software implementation and build-out from our certified administrators empower your lending workflow so you can smoothly and efficiently serve your clients and maintain professional sanctity from start to finish. From standard to advanced Encompass implementation packages, we offer you the freedom to choose what best suits your company standards and budget. Plus, you don’t have to worry about pesky details or going out of finances. We will carefully assess your requirements and help you pick the most suitable package while minimizing the cost and effort of migrating from your existing loan servicing software to Encompass® LOS. Partner with us today and experience ‘out of the box’ Encompass® implementation. What Percentage Of Lenders Use Encompass? Encompass is the number one loan origination system in the mortgage industry, making loans easy for over 3,100 lenders and investors. It’s considered the best choice for automating the loan process. Encompass Software Implementation Process Phases Of Our Ellie Mae Encompass Implementation Project: From Introduction To Completion Implementation Project Management We start the Encompass setup process by understanding your project objectives and goals. Together, we define the scope of the implementation, identifying the specific modules and features that align with your lending business. Thorough Requirements Gathering Our team engages with key stakeholders, including loan officers and underwriters, to comprehend your workflows and unique needs deeply. We analyze your existing processes to integrate them into the Encompass® system. Flawless System Configuration Leveraging our extensive experience, we precisely configure the Encompass® system to match your gathered requirements. This includes setting up customized workflows, defining roles, and establishing access levels for different users. Data Migration and Integration With our Encompass® migration services, data transfer becomes a breeze. We extract and transfer data from your existing system, ensuring its integrity. Configuration, Testing, Deployment Before the final rollout, we conduct strict testing to ensure all functionalities work flawlessly. A pilot deployment with a small group of users helps us gather feedback for further refinement. Smooth Rollout and Go-Live After incorporating the necessary adjustments, we proceed with the full-scale deployment of the Encompass® system to your organization. Our team ensures adequate support during the critical go-live phase. Post-Implementation Support Our support continues after implementing Encompass. We provide post-implementation support to address any issues and continuously optimize your Encompass® system based on user feedback and changing business needs. Thorough Documentation We maintain detailed documentation of the Encompass® configuration, integrations, and customizations for future reference. Project Review and Closure After successful implementation, we conduct a project review to assess its success and identify areas for improvement. Your feedback is crucial to ensure your satisfaction. WE MASTER EVERYTHING ENCOMPASS® Whether you’re venturing into Encompass® for the first time or seeking to refine your current configuration, count on us for exceptional solutions Our Hand-Crafted Plugins & Solutions Make Your Encompass® Instance Better EXPLORE ALL AN ABUNDANCE OF TECHNOLOGICAL DELIGHTS Discover the transformative power of these incredible tools that fit into your loan-originating system. Built with security and compliance in mind, our plugins adhere to industry standards to safeguard sensitive loan data. Home Counseling Zip Code API Knock Knock Notice of Assignment Form/Loan Assignment Manager/ Organizational Details/ Update Fields Using Branch Description Cenlar Servicing Encompass Customization & Integrations We Offer At Awesome Technologies Inc., we understand how mortgage lending technology works. We use Encompass SDK Programming to create tools that save time and resources. Before we start customization of Encompass , we make sure to analyze and gather requirements properly. This is crucial because custom programming can take time and be costly if requirements aren’t clear. We do the best of our work in business analysis, implementation, and administration as a key to developing high-quality custom tools. Not only customization, Our encompass® Integration Services are customized to meet your unique business needs. We understand that every organization has specific requirements, and we take pride in delivering bespoke solutions that align perfectly with your workflows and objectives. Whether you need to connect your Encompass® instance with CRM systems, document management tools, or any other third-party applications, our software engineers have what it takes to make it happen. CRM, POS & Document Management Integrations Effortlessly connect Encompass loans software and leading CRMs, Point-of-Sale tools and eDocument systems. Increase borrower experience and internal visibility with automated data flow and centralized records. Examples of integrations we can support include Salesforce, Jungo, Blend, Floify, Byte, etc. Workflow Automation & Task Management We create smart workflows which automatically assign tasks, send emails, update loan status, etc. Remove bottlenecks by eliminating repetitive tasks using customized automation rules. Your team will spend less time clicking and more time closing loans. Custom Reporting Dashboards & Business Rules See live visibility into your pipeline health, performance metrics, and compliance indicators. We create real-time dashboards customized for your executive, compliance, and operations teams. Our automated business rules help ensure consistency while in Encompass mortgage implementation, minimizing human error and risk. Benefits of Our Implementation Services Improved Loan Processing Efficiency Accelerate your entire loan lifecycle with efficient workflows and fewer transitions. Clients consistently see at least a 40% improvement in loan processing times after implementing our optimized Encompass setups. More efficient closings mean more satisfied borrowers and more revenue potential, thanks to our Encompass implementation services! Decreased Manual Workload Digitally eliminate manual entry and the need for re-keying and duplication across systems. Custom scripts, task automations, and integrations reduce your team's manual workload. Free your people up for better borrower service and better loan quality—not administrative work. Reduced Compliance Risks Built-in rules, alerts, and checks help guide every loan through compliant processes that align with federal expectations and investor requirements. Be audit-ready with audit trails, documentation tracking, and automated disclosures. Our well-designed Encompass systems help you avoid costly pitfalls with a system built for compliance from the ground up. Better Team Productivity & Reporting Help your team work efficiently and productively through tools that provide visibility into the right information at the right time. Real-time dashboards with actionable insights enable managers to make smarter decisions and lead the team effectively. Improved visibility into distributed team performance and accountability and faster decision making. Benefits of Our Implementation Services Mortgage Loan Origination Systems We Serve Our experts can work on every major LOS to make your mortgage operations swift. Our Encompass Implementation Process Discovery & Requirement Gathering Our first step is to look deeply into your current lending process to determine major pain points and opportunities. Our staff will work alongside various stakeholders to gain a full understanding of the functional, technical, and compliance requirements, leaving us with a well-documented outline of the system outlining your new solution that fits perfectly into your operations. System Design & Customization We incorporate your loan products into your system, along with the associated workflows, compliance rules, and departmental duties. Custom screens, fields, and automations are developed to tailor fit the way your team will be doing your work - not just some generic templates! It's flexible, tailored, and intended for future growth and ease of use. Data Migration & Validation Our team will securely and accurately migrate your existing loan data to Encompass. We'll run all necessary validation processes to confirm data accuracy and integrity, all without missing a beat in your pipeline. We will act to ensure that you have as little 'downtime' as possible, and your compliance posture is not impacted throughout the process. Final Testing, Staff Training & Go-Live Before your system or Encompass application goes live, we'll conduct detailed testing scenarios to meet the same standards of performance and accuracy in the new system. We train your staff to provide hands-on training best suited to warrant the changeover, to ensure adoption and staff still have confidence in how to leverage your new systems functionality. Our staff will be with yours through the go-live and post-deployment support to ensure you receive the very best delivery of service possible. Encompass Implementation with Awesome Technologies When you trust us to implement or re-implement your Encompass®, we take the time to learn about your whole lending process. We guide you with system configuration and explain what each part of Encompass360 does and how it’s meant to be used. Our goal is to ensure you feel comfortable and capable of handling things on your own once the project is done. Selecting the perfect partner for this crucial moment in your business should be your top priority. Awesome Technologies Inc. has successfully implemented Encompass® for over ten years without any failed implementations. Don’t hesitate to contact your peers, trusted advisors, or the community to hear about our track record. Feel free to email us or visit our website for more details. Looking For Something Else? Find answers to common questions about our Encompass® Implementation Services How long does it take to implement Encompass? The vast majority of all Encompass implementations take 4 to 8 weeks depending on your organization and workflows. Because most lenders are complicated and are diverse with respect to integrations, we have implemented a phased approach to make the implementation as seamless as possible and have minimal disruption to your day-to-day activities. Will you migrate my data from my old LOS? Yes. We do this on a regular basis and have gone through the complete security onboarding for migrating or integrating legacy loan origination systems to Encompass. We will do 100% data-mapping, data-cleaning, and validation of the data we were able to transfer. We want to make sure that the data is accurate, compliant data, and has continuity. We don’t want to risk losing any critical data during the transition. Is your implementation support US-based? Yes. All of our entire implementation and support team is 100% US based. All of our support and implementation professionals have substantial mortgage technology experience using Encompass and the best procedures for implementation within Encompass. This will allow for minimal time to respond, execute in real-time and be fully compliant with US regulations. How much does Encompass integration cost? Typically, Encompass integration work costs between $3,000 – $15,000 depending on the systems we need to integrate (e.g. CRM, POS, doc management), the level of customization, and the complexity of your workflow. We also offer pricing transparency and will provide custom pricing packages and or options after a discovery call to fit your budget and goals. Do you provide support after going live? Yes! After your go live, we will continue to provide support and optimize your system to ensure you are receiving the benefits of your investment while also offering help desk access for troubleshooting purposes, compliance updates, reporting enhancements, and performance tuning to help you run your Encompass system at its peak performance! Do you support once a client goes live? Yes! We offer ongoing support, maintenance, as well as optimizing the system post implementation. This includes troubleshooting, compliance updates, performance tuning, as well as reporting enhancements. Why Awesome Technologies Inc for Encompass implementation? We are a partner you can trust, with certified Encompass consultants, a proven record of success with mortgage firms throughout the U.S., and have unmatched prior knowledge not only in technology set-up, but also lending operations. We want to ensure your LOS is streamlined, less risk, and rely on ROI. If there’s anything else you’d like to know about Encompass® Implementation Services , feel free to reach out. sections.title: Certified Ellie Mae Encompass Consultants
sections.content: Our certified consultants have a comprehensive understanding of Ellie Mae Encompass architecture and compliance framework. They are always updated with recent releases, to be able to set up the most future-proof system configuration. Why not work with a licensed professional that will help you secure your LOS in alignment with what makes business sense and what is required by lenders on behalf of federal regulatory bodies?

sections.title: Proven Success with Mortgage Firms in the U.S.
sections.content: Thinking of how to implement Encompass loan origination system? We have a successful track record delivering seamless LOS implementations to retail, wholesale and correspondent lenders in over 30 states. Post LOS implementation details and contacts indicate money and time saved based on faster closing time, less compliance issues, and ultimately a better return on their investment. Case studies and client testimonials evidence the dedication of mortgage tech we have for excellence, implementation, and measurable outcomes.

sections.title: End-to-End Technical & Functional Support
sections.content: From initial designs to long-term maintenance, we offer unrivaled support related to all functional and technical aspects of Encompass software for mortgage. Our consultants are able to assist lenders and title companies immediately with complex configuration, integrations and optimization after they go live. Lenders will experience less internal burden on their teams if they outsource their Encompass needs to a trusted, responsive partner.

sections.title: Implementation Project Management
sections.content: We start the Encompass setup process by understanding your project objectives and goals. Together, we define the scope of the implementation, identifying the specific modules and features that align with your lending business.

sections.title: Thorough Requirements Gathering
sections.content: Our team engages with key stakeholders, including loan officers and underwriters, to comprehend your workflows and unique needs deeply. We analyze your existing processes to integrate them into the Encompass® system.

sections.title: Flawless System Configuration
sections.content: Leveraging our extensive experience, we precisely configure the Encompass® system to match your gathered requirements. This includes setting up customized workflows, defining roles, and establishing access levels for different users.

sections.title: Data Migration and Integration
sections.content: With our Encompass® migration services, data transfer becomes a breeze. We extract and transfer data from your existing system, ensuring its integrity.

sections.title: Configuration, Testing, Deployment
sections.content: Before the final rollout, we conduct strict testing to ensure all functionalities work flawlessly. A pilot deployment with a small group of users helps us gather feedback for further refinement.

sections.title: Smooth Rollout and Go-Live
sections.content: After incorporating the necessary adjustments, we proceed with the full-scale deployment of the Encompass® system to your organization. Our team ensures adequate support during the critical go-live phase.

sections.title: Post-Implementation Support
sections.content: Our support continues after implementing Encompass. We provide post-implementation support to address any issues and continuously optimize your Encompass® system based on user feedback and changing business needs.

sections.title: Thorough Documentation
sections.content: We maintain detailed documentation of the Encompass® configuration, integrations, and customizations for future reference.

sections.title: Project Review and Closure
sections.content: After successful implementation, we conduct a project review to assess its success and identify areas for improvement. Your feedback is crucial to ensure your satisfaction.
